newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Westpac cuts Australian business rates.
newsitem.headline: Westpac cuts Australian business rates.

text.p: Westpac Banking Corp said it cut its business lending rates by up to 0.55 percentage points following the cut in official cash rates to 5.0 percent from 5.5 percent by the Reserve Bank earlier on Wednesday.
The prime Indicator Lending Rate for business overdrafts and term loans was cut to 8.75 percent from 9.25 percent, it said.

Its business development loan rate was cut to 6.99 percent from 7.5 percent, its business equity line of credit to 7.20 percent from 7.55 and its mortgage-free business finance to 11.45 percent from 11.95. All the cuts are effective September 8.
